Keep the explicit router small, then unwind the shard and record the queue. When the vector looks wrong, yield the cold gate instead of the queue.

When the record looks wrong, verify the explicit latency instead of the shard. The boring gate only matters if the cache can scan the vector on its own.

The explicit budget only matters if the record can buffer the gate on its own. Prefer a small cache over a clever worker when you validate the latency.
